excerpts.text: You have been trying to conceive long enough that a fertility assessment is usually discussed at this point.
excerpts.source_hint: TO BE CONFIRMED BY CLINICAL ADVISOR (AUA/ASRM; EAU)

excerpts.text: With the timing you shared, earlier follow-up is usually discussed.
